In this notebook, I will create plots for supplemental figure 2

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)


thisseed <- 231103
```

## Colonic Epithelium

```{r}
seuobj.colepi <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_colepi_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj.colepi
```

```{r}
markers.colepi <- c(    
  'RARRES2', 'LEFTY1',
  'CA1', 'CEACAM7', 'CCL23', 'BEST4', 
  'SPINK4', 'ZG16', 'CCL24', 'REG3A', 'REG4',
  'LGR5', 'PI3', 'SAA1', 'SAA2',
  'PLCG2', 'LRMP', 'NREP', 
  'NEUROG3', 'PYY', 'GCG', 'TPH1',
  'MKI67'
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=15}
accuracy.colepi <- seuobj.colepi@meta.data %>% 
  count(cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(accuracy = ifelse(n > 1e3, 0.1, 1)) %>%
  pull(accuracy)

(
  ggplot(seuobj.colepi@meta.data %>% 
           group_by(cellstate) %>% 
           mutate(n = n(), diversity = vegan::diversity(table(biopsy), "simpson")) %>% 
           ungroup %>% 
           arrange(cellstate) %>% 
           distinct(cellstate, n, diversity, celltype), aes(x = cellstate, y = n)) + 
    geom_col(aes(fill = diversity, color = diversity)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_number(accuracy = accuracy.colepi, scale_cut = cut_short_scale())(n)), 
              nudge_y = 1000, fontface="bold", size = 5) + 
    facet_grid(~celltype, space = "free", scales = "free") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "identity", labels = NULL) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = guide_colorbar(barheight = 15)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.025, "cm"), 
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = "white"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")  
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Simpson\nIndex",
         title = sprintf("Colonic Epithelial Cells (n = %s)", label_comma()(ncol(seuobj.colepi))))
) / 
  
  (
    DotPlot(
      seuobj.colepi, 
      features =  markers.colepi, 
      group.by = "cellstate", 
      scale=F) + 
      # scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
      scale_size_continuous(limits = c(0,100), range = c(1, 10)) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "gray80", high = "red") +
      # scale_colour_viridis_c() +
      RotatedAxis() +
      labs(x = "", y = "") +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray80"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      ) +
      guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "LogExp", order = 1), size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp", order = 2)) + 
      coord_flip()
  ) + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(5, 9))
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=19.5}
accuracy.stroma <- seuobj.stroma@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::count(cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(accuracy = ifelse(n > 1e3, 0.1, 1)) %>%
  pull(accuracy)

(
  ggplot(seuobj.stroma@meta.data %>% 
           group_by(cellstate) %>% 
           mutate(n = n(), diversity = vegan::diversity(table(biopsy), "simpson")) %>% 
           ungroup %>% 
           arrange(cellstate) %>% 
           distinct(cellstate, celltype, n, diversity), aes(x = cellstate, y = n)) + 
    geom_col(aes(fill = diversity, color = diversity)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_number(accuracy = accuracy.stroma, scale_cut = cut_short_scale())(n)), 
              nudge_y = 1000, fontface="bold", size = 5) + 
    facet_grid(~celltype, space = "free", scales = "free") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "identity", labels = NULL) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = guide_colorbar(barheight = 15)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.025, "cm"), 
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = "white"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")  
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Simpson\nIndex",
         title = sprintf("Stromal and Endothelial Cells (n = %s)", label_comma()(ncol(seuobj.stroma))))
)/ 
  
  (
    DotPlot(
      seuobj.stroma, 
      features =  markers.stroma, 
      group.by = "cellstate", 
      scale=F) + 
      # scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
      scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
      scale_size_continuous(limits = c(0,100), range = c(1, 10)) +
      scale_color_gradient2(midpoint = 1, low = "gray40", mid = "gray80", high = "red") +
      # scale_colour_viridis_c() +
      RotatedAxis() +
      labs(x = "", y = "") +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray80"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      ) +
      guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "LogExp", order = 1), size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp", order = 2)) + 
      coord_flip()
  ) + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(5, 11.5))
```
